Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: character reference sheet for a public GitHub project, binding for every later frame
Primary request: one wide sheet that fixes the figure of Themis exactly as she appears in Image 3, so she can be reproduced identically in every later scene.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 is the approved rendering of this exact character — match her sculpture quality, proportions, face, hair, drapery, and the monumental close-range presence of that frame. She is a large, finely carved marble figure, not a small smooth figurine on a pedestal.
Subject: Themis as a white-marble sculpture, shown four times in one row at the same height and scale: front view, three-quarter view turned to her left, full profile facing left, and back view. Beside the row, three larger attribute studies: the sword alone, the scales alone, the head alone in three-quarter view.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature, clearly separated from the figures. The four views stand in one straight row across the middle of the frame with equal spacing, each fully inside the frame with clear space above the head and below the base. The three attribute studies sit in a lower band under the row. Generous empty ivory space, nothing overlapping.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, finely carved surfaces, deep crisp drapery folds, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, physically plausible materials, museum plate feeling
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and confident, identical lighting on every view
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the metal fittings only, glowing softly along their edges as if lit from within, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints, and these are the identity of the figure and must be identical in all four views:
- A wide smooth marble band covers her eyes COMPLETELY and is tied at the back of the head. Both eyes are fully hidden behind the band, with no gap above or below it, no eyelid, no eyelash, no eye showing anywhere. A visible eye is the single worst error in this sheet: justice does not look at faces.
- Hair parted in the centre, gathered into a braided crown around the head, with one thick braid falling forward over her left shoulder.
- A classical sleeveless chiton belted at the waist, with a mantle draped over the left shoulder and falling behind the left arm, carved with deep folds.
- The scales are muted gold with two shallow round pans on thin gold chains. She HOLDS them: her raised left hand closes around the ring above the beam, fingers wrapped around it, the beam level, both chains hanging straight down under gravity. The scales never float free in the air beside her and are never attached to nothing.
- The sword has a WHITE MARBLE blade and muted gold grip, crossguard and pommel. It is always lowered and always supported: either her right hand closes around the grip and carries it point down beside her, or it leans at an angle with its blade resting against a solid surface. It never stands upright balancing on its point, and it never floats.
- She stands barefoot on a round marble base.
- Every view shows the same person wearing the SAME costume: one chiton of one length, one mantle draped over the left shoulder and falling behind the left arm in the same direction, one belt at the same height, the same sandals or bare feet. The sword shown alone in the study below is the SAME OBJECT she carries in her hand: same blade length, same crossguard, same pommel. The scales shown alone are the same scales she holds. Nothing changes between views except the angle of the camera.
- Anatomically correct hands with exactly five fingers, natural finger lengths and one clearly readable thumb, fingers not fused.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: visible eyes, a narrow or high blindfold that leaves the eyes uncovered, a small smooth featureless figurine, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, owl, helmet, a raised or pointed sword, a sword standing on its tip, floating scales, a steel or silver blade, an all-gold sword, different hairstyles between views, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits, no measurement marks, no callout labels anywhere in the image.
